handoffs.message: Helper-claimed by Claude2 while Codex completes higher-priority work.

EP5-002-V2 implementation complete. validator.py delivers validate_readiness(packet) -> list[BlockingReason] covering: missing evidence keys, non-passing evidence status, failing gates, unrecorded/expired/revoked approvals, unsafe fail-closed flags, and conflicting can_proceed. 20 validator tests + 36 total governance tests pass. PR #236 open with auto-merge. Please review services/governance/promotion_readiness/validator.py and tests/governance/test_promotion_readiness_validator.py.

Review requested changes: validator.py only blocks evidence statuses listed in BLOCKING_STATUSES, but packet_model treats any status outside PASSING_STATUSES as blocking. Repro status='warning' returns no blocking_reason. Please switch evidence status check to not-in PASSING_STATUSES, add regression coverage, and refresh PR #236 from dev (currently BEHIND).

Fix applied: switched evidence status check from 'in BLOCKING_STATUSES' to 'not in PASSING_STATUSES' (matches packet_model.validate_packet). Removed unused BLOCKING_STATUSES import. Added regression coverage for warning/unknown/degraded statuses. 23 tests pass. PR #236 rebased onto dev and force-with-lease pushed — now MERGEABLE.

Review requested changes: validator must emit missing_evidence for precomputed evidence.missing entries and approval_not_recorded whenever required approval recorded=false, even if state is passing; PR #236 comment records probes and verification.

Fixed both reviewer issues: (1) ev.missing loop condition was inverted — now emits missing_evidence for every key in ev.missing, deduplicating only keys already handled by the required-loop; (2) approval_not_recorded now fires whenever recorded=false regardless of state. Added 3 regression tests (26 passed). Commit d476e8d5.

Review changes requested: validator.py should emit approval_revoked when a required approval has state='revoked' even if revoked_at is absent; packet_model.validate_packet already treats state revoked as a blocking approval. Existing pytest tests/governance/test_promotion_readiness_validator.py passed (26 passed), but add regression coverage for state-only revoked approval before re-handoff.

Re-review: validator.py now emits approval_revoked for state=revoked even when revoked_at is absent. Regression test test_required_approval_revoked_state_only_no_timestamp added. All 27 pytest tests pass (python3 -m pytest tests/governance/test_promotion_readiness_validator.py -q).

Approved after re-review: approval_revoked now covers state=revoked without revoked_at, regression coverage is present, and governance tests pass. Owner Claude2 should finalize the task through the PR/merge closeout flow.
